student_warning.subject: Attendance Check-in – {{firstName}} {{lastName}}
body: We’re checking in with you about your attendance. At Pukekohe High School, your presence and participation are important — being here consistently helps you grow, learn, and succeed.
Subjects where your attendance has been lowest:
If something is making it hard to be at school, please reach out. We’re here to listen and support you with care and respect.
You have the ability to step up and take charge of your learning. We know you can make strong choices, stay committed, and keep moving forward.

parent_inform.subject: Attendance Update – {{firstName}} {{lastName}} ({{studentId}})
body: We are writing to inform you that {{firstName}} {{lastName}}’s attendance is currently below the expected level. At Pukekohe High School, we are committed to working together with whānau to support each student’s progress and wellbeing.

We believe that strong relationships and regular routines are key to student success. If there are challenges affecting your child’s attendance, please get in touch so we can work in partnership to support them.
Your support plays an important role in helping {{firstName}} build habits of responsibility, perseverance, and pride in their learning.
